$comment: Every field path the manifest schema declares and no build has ever produced.
The schema is a published contract with additionalProperties: false at every level, so a
field in it is a promise. A field nothing writes breaks that promise in the direction
nobody notices: a consumer reading an absent field is told THIS APPLICATION HAS NONE,
when the truth is NOBODY LOOKED. Those are opposite facts and an empty document reports
This register is what turns that from a review convention into a gate. Adding a field to
the schema without a producer now fails ManifestProducerTests until a row is written here
with a reason, and closing a field fails until its row is removed. The list can shrink and
HOW THE SET IS COMPUTED. Every path in schemas/flowx.manifest.schema.json, against every
path present in any manifest a build in this repository emitted -- twelve of them, across
the platform and every sample. That is the method ADR-0017 section 1 describes and did by
hand; doing it by hand undercounted, which is the argument for doing it here instead.
A path absent from every emitted manifest is one of two things, and the register says
which: nothing writes it at all, or something writes it and no application in this
repository declares the thing it describes. The second is a weaker debt -- the producer
exists and is untested -- but it is still a field a consumer cannot rely on.

unproduced.why: The build knows it. Small to close, and flowx diff ignores it by design (docs/22-CLI.md 2.2), so it would arrive with no classification work.

There is no owner attribute. A DSL addition, and the one 13-AI-Native section 3 claims is already carried.

A flow's source is emitted from the symbol's location; a capability reaches the writer as a step reference, which does not carry one. Closing it means threading the declaration site through the model.

Deliberate, and the one row here that is not debt. A subscriber is an estate-wide fact and one compilation sees only its own, so writing it would publish a list that is complete for this service and silently partial for the question anybody asks it (ADR-0039).

By design nobody's but the consumer's -- and untested because of it. ADR-0017 F6 makes exercising it a freeze criterion precisely because an escape hatch nobody has used is an escape hatch nobody knows works.
